objective: Add a contract test that pins the Pi events the HolyAgent integration consumes to the pinned Pi version, using fixtures built from Pi 1.5.0's sources, so a Pi update that changes them fails CI until the fixtures are re-recorded.
scope: Worktree: /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-contract (branch release/0.3.0/test/pi-event-contract). Work and run every command there.

Find every Pi event and message shape the integration consumes: the agent_settled mapping in packages/runtime/src/pi/journal.ts:259-263, the specialist launcher's reading of child pi output (JSON or RPC mode), the extension's handlers in packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts (message_end, tool_call, session events), tool execution events, and the extension_ui_request messages of RPC mode (select, confirm, input, editor, notify, setStatus), which T3 Code renders.

Build the fixtures from the installed Pi host's own sources and type declarations (node_modules/.bun/@earendil-works+pi-coding-agent@1.5.0 or wherever bun resolves @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent); never run pi. Store them as JSONL files under packages/integrations/pi/tests/fixtures/, each recording the Pi version it was built for. Where possible, check the fixtures against Pi's exported types at type-check time as well as at run time.

The test feeds each fixture through the integration's real consumers (the journal mapping, the launcher's parser, the extension handlers with a stub Pi API) and asserts the result, and fails when the installed Pi version differs from the fixtures' recorded version, with a message that says to re-record them. Document how to re-record in docs/development.md, next to the deps:update text, and in a short README beside the fixtures if the repository keeps such notes elsewhere.
If a consumer cannot be exercised without changing source code, report the change it needs instead of making it, because other branches change those files now.
constraints: Before anything else, run `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in your worktree, because node_modules is not shared between worktrees; the prepare step installing lefthook hooks is expected.
Make no git writes (no commit, add, checkout, stash, branch) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; the root commits. Report your changed paths.

Follow the repository rules in .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md of the worktree: Effect for effects and errors with tagged errors (no try/catch, new Promise, Promise statics or async functions in runtime and CLI source), Effect Schema at data boundaries with onExcessProperty error, Bun APIs and the Bun Shell, JSDoc on every exported function and type.
Testing is unit tests and recorded or synthesized fixtures only: never start pi, a Pi session, T3 Code or a Kimi request.

Gates, run in your worktree: `bunx --no-install mise run build` (commit-ready generated output; the tree must have no unexplained changes after it) and `bunx --no-install mise run verify` (type-check, lint, format check, tests) must exit 0. Give the command, exit code and test counts.

Write `git diff` of your change (after the build) to a file outside the repository in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path as diff-file evidence.
Build only what the Assignment asks; name any further improvement in the report instead of adding it.
Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file in the scratchpad above and give its path.

criteria.text: Fixtures cover every Pi event shape the integration consumes, including agent_settled, the tool events and each extension_ui_request method, and each records the Pi version
Each fixture runs through the integration's real consumer and the test asserts the outcome
The test fails with a re-record message when the installed Pi version differs from the fixtures' version, shown by a test or a demonstrated run
